description: This file defines the PayGrade class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for filtering reports based on pay grade. It extends a FilterField class and implements ValueXNormalizable interface, encapsulating methods to modify database query filters and convert pay grade data to array representations.

classes.name: PayGrade
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering entities based on their pay grade within report generation in OrangeHRM. Implements methods to add filtering conditions to queries and to convert pay grade data to array format.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query builder to filter records where the pay grade matches a specified value if the operator is EQUAL and 'x' value is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns entity aliases used in the query, in this case, ['salary'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Fetches and converts the pay grade entity corresponding to 'x' into an array with 'id' and 'label'.
